silhouette: Asymmetrical bulbous mass with an overarching handle and a projecting curved spout on the right.
viewpoint: Three-quarter view from the front-right to clearly display the spout, body volume, handle arch, and lid simultaneously.

parts.name: Rounded Body
parts.shape: Sphere-like bulbous cylinder with a flattened stable base and slightly tapered upper shoulder.
parts.connection: Serves as the central anchor to which the base, spout, handle brackets, and lid are directly attached.

parts.name: Curved Spout
parts.shape: Elongated tapered conical tube curving upward and outward with an open diagonal cut mouth.
parts.connection: Welded seamlessly to the lower-right side of the rounded body.

parts.name: Arched Top Handle
parts.shape: Thick semi-circular curved strap spanning across the top diameter of the kettle.
parts.connection: Anchored firmly by two vertical brackets on opposite sides of the kettle's upper shoulder.

parts.name: Lid
parts.shape: Circular flanged disc fitting securely into the top opening of the rounded body.
parts.connection: Rests snugly inside the top collar of the rounded body with a stepped rim.

parts.name: Small Knob
parts.shape: Small spherical or cylindrical grip positioned centrally on top of the lid.
parts.connection: Mounted to the exact center of the lid's top surface.

recognitionCues: Distinct curved spout projecting from the side with an open angled tip
High arching metal handle spanning overhead
Removable lid with a central lifting knob on the top surface
Metallic sheen lines indicating a rounded, reflective cylindrical body
avoid: Featureless blob-like body without structural seams
Banana-like elongated tapering flaps or peel anatomy
Improbable angles that hide the spout and handle simultaneously
